_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for names, ages, and the story calendar. roster.txt and ages.md are GENERATED from this file by tools/age_ledger.py. Never hand-edit a generated file. To add a character, add them here and re-run the tool.

calendar.note: Absolute years. Every chapter frontmatter must carry a `year:` matching one of these volumes.

characters.name: Casian
characters.note: Unmatched Current-user. The easy brother by choice.

characters.name: Edric
characters.note: Good lord, good father, sees an ordinary son.

characters.name: Maren
characters.note: Knows something is different and has decided not to make it a thing.

characters.name: Oswin
characters.note: Sharp, old, suspects plenty, says little.

characters.name: Aldric
characters.note: Married to Rowan. Steady.

characters.name: Emric
characters.note: An infant in Vol 1. Ages fastest of anyone — check the table every volume.

characters.name: Gareth
characters.note: The sword.

characters.name: Brennan
characters.note: The charm.

characters.name: Elna
characters.note: His soft spot. Not a hostage. Never a hostage.

characters.name: Argius
characters.note: Not born. Ageless. The only one who remembers.

characters.name: Vesna
characters.note: Becomes formidable because she works. The counter-evidence to dependency. NOT a romance lane.

characters.name: Corin
characters.note: Runs the unglamorous operations.

characters.name: Maeve
characters.note: Reads ledgers better than anyone alive.

characters.name: Jory
characters.note: Loyal to the baron, slowly to something else.

characters.name: Ansel
characters.note: Knows every debt on the eastern road.

characters.name: Aldous
characters.note: The first man Casian cannot save fast enough.

characters.name: Calla
characters.note: Competent. Watching the Vale barony change.

characters.name: Seraine
characters.note: THE romance lane. The legitimate answer: make the east safe by law, not by Casian. Must never be reduced to a love interest — her own assessment is often correct.

characters.name: Sabeth
characters.note: THE question: asks him plainly whether he wants to be unnecessary, and does not accept charm. NOT a romance lane. Never softens into an ally who was on his side all along.

characters.name: Hask Veyr
characters.note: Cruel, patient, genuinely dangerous.

characters.name: Osric
characters.note: Funds Hask quietly. Mistakes sentiment for weakness.

characters.name: Selwyn
characters.role: Warden of the Ashen Word, eastern circuit
characters.note: Bureaucrat, believer, not a monster. Survives the series and is never converted.

characters.name: Vaunt
characters.note: Competent, and learns too much. Lives.

characters.name: Ferrand
characters.note: Cruel. Does not survive the year.

characters.name: Lennah
characters.note: Burned. The reason Casian can never speak. Do not reuse the name.

characters.name: Ilse
characters.role: forced the Current; dying of it
characters.note: The mirror. Wants what Casian wants. Two years left at first meeting.

characters.name: Halden
characters.note: Loyal, unsentimental. Survives her.

characters.name: Tace
characters.role: 14 in Vol 3; one of Ilse's people
characters.note: The reason her project looks the way it does.

characters.name: Lucan
characters.note: Elegant, competitive. Thinks every house has a price. Not erased. Lives.

characters.name: Caedmon
characters.note: Observant, dry, loyal to the Crown rather than any faction.

characters.name: Orlan
characters.note: Blunt soldier. Thinks the eastern Compact must be measured.

characters.name: Severin
characters.note: Placeholder — confirm before volume 5 planning.

characters.name: Ivara
characters.note: Placeholder.

characters.name: Tarek
characters.note: Placeholder.
